questions.question: SKILL.md frontmatter claims Apache 2.0 but the tree ships no LICENSE file; what is the actual redistribution permission?
questions.recommendation: Obtain the license text or correct the frontmatter claim before any redistribution or promotion; treat permission as unknown until then.
questions.rationale: Inventory licenseStatus is unknown and no license bytes exist in-tree to preserve or grant rights.

questions.question: Should impeccable ship as core or as an optional pack?
questions.recommendation: Ship as optional-frontend-craft; core membership needs workflow evidence, not collection size.
questions.rationale: Installation is not usage evidence; the skill is a large opt-in design workflow with its own authority footprint.

questions.question: Live mode binds a localhost helper, injects scripts into user pages, patches CSP sources, and writes user source files — is that authority boundary acceptable for promotion?
questions.recommendation: Keep per-project consent, dev-only guards, and the verbatim CSP consent prompt; do not broaden silently.
questions.rationale: The capability (local server plus external writes into user projects) is the highest-risk surface in the tree.

questions.question: The hook auto-runs the detector after edits and on Cursor can block writes — what consent governs auto-execution and write-gating?
questions.recommendation: Keep opt-in per project with a recorded consent decision; never enable as a side effect of design work.
questions.rationale: Automatic post-edit execution and pre-write blocking change agent behavior without a per-turn user decision.

questions.question: The API image fallback spends the user's OpenAI credit at roughly $0.05-0.25 per image — is the cost consent and key handling sufficient?
questions.recommendation: Keep the pre-first-call cost statement, harness-native-first routing, and the offline fake fixture; no spend without the stated disclosure.
questions.rationale: Credential use plus real spend needs explicit, repeatable consent wording.

questions.question: concept-seed.mjs contacts https://impeccable.style/api (roll plus one choice ping per resolved round) — is that network/telemetry default acceptable?
questions.recommendation: Keep DO_NOT_TRACK / IMPECCABLE_NO_TELEMETRY opt-outs and the offline degraded path; no new sinks without review.
questions.rationale: Default-on network contact from a design skill needs a recorded human posture on telemetry.
